summary: Iteration 33 — Removed legacy $399 12-month Progress Pass UI and added in-dashboard UpgradeBanner. All backend regression tests (7/7) and all 14 critical frontend assertions passed. Free + Premium users see the new dashboard-upgrade-banner with $29.99 / $49.99 cards; clicking either button fires POST /api/payments/subscribe with correct tier and navigates to checkout.stripe.com. Admin Settings tab no longer renders the 12-month price card (admin-pass-price-input fully removed; admin Single Report Price card with data-testid='admin-price-input' is intact, still at $159). LandingMinimal FAQ now references 'single report and the monthly plans' with Premium $29.99 + VIP $49.99 in the answer; no $399 or '3 reports across 365 days' remains. Mobile (390x844) renders cards stacked vertically. No console errors on admin Settings.
action_items: Minor doc nit: the review_request referenced data-testid 'admin-report-price-input' but the actual element in AdminPage.jsx uses 'admin-price-input'. Functionality is correct; only the docstring/expectation in the request was off. Consider renaming the testid to 'admin-report-price-input' for clarity since there is no longer a 'pass price' to disambiguate against.
(Out of scope for this iter) server.py is 8000+ lines — split into routers per code-review guidelines.

AdminPage.jsx still keeps the passPrice/passPriceInput state + handlePassPriceSave handler even though the UI card is removed (dead code). Safe to delete the handler + state since /settings/price still returns pass_price but nothing in the UI consumes it. Low priority.
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardPage.jsx UpgradeBanner is gated cleanly on (!subscription?.tier && !passState?.active) — correct dual-gate so subscribed users and legacy pass-holders are not double-promoted.
PlayerRow.onUpgradeClick now smooth-scrolls to dashboard-upgrade-banner (verified element + testid match) — no modal opens, as required.
/api/settings/price still returns pass_price field for backward compat — confirmed in regression test. Good defensive choice.
POST /api/payments/subscribe correctly accepts tier='premium'|'vip' and rejects unknown tier with 400/422 (verified).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 14 critical assertions; 2 substring checks failed only due to CSS text-transform:uppercase but visual screenshot confirmed text is rendered correctly)

seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded test users. Two new kind='subscription' payment_transactions rows (initiated, no payment completed) created when clicking premium and VIP CTAs to obtain checkout URLs. Same pattern as iter32.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All UI removal + new UpgradeBanner verified. Stripe is LIVE — tests stop at hosted Stripe checkout page (cs_live_*). Note that the UpgradeBanner only renders when (!subscription?.tier && !passState?.active). To test an *active* subscription flow (SubscriptionCard render, cancel/resume/change-tier), either flip Stripe to TEST mode + complete a 4242 card, or manually patch users.subscription in Mongo as documented in iter32 context.
